messages:
harper: quick sync - scheduled a slow ramp for metrics-proxy in the 04:00 UTC change window. want to minimize regrowth of cold metrics caches.

felix: propose steps?

harper: deploy with FF off. then +10m -> 0.25%, +25m -> 1%, +50m -> 10%, +80m -> 100%. auto-pause on infra alerts and rollback if error_rate>0.5% sustained 3m or p95_delta>70ms. pin routing to metrics-proxy-v1 on rollback.

anya: can deploy-bot handle quarter-percent steps? that's new to our scheduler.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle tb-6499999999-Q; flag=metrics_rewrite_v2; schedule=[+10m:0.25%,+25m:1%,+50m:10%,+80m:100%]; pause_on_alert=infra.*; rollback_triggers=[err>0.5,p95>70]; sticky_cohort=internal_metrics; initiator=harper

ops-oncall: pre-staging pin pin-6499999999-eu ready: target=router-metrics-v1; will apply on rollback. Kill: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6499999999-Q`. Dashboard link shared.

smoke-bot: smoke test configured: `ci/smoke/metrics_smoke.sh` will run after each step; posting results here.

harper: I'll push the PR and include deploy command: `./deploy --svc=metrics-proxy --image=redwood/metrics:prod-2 --ff=metrics_rewrite_v2=off`. Standby from 03:40 UTC.

(Deploy logs)
```
Deploy started: metrics-proxy v2
Image: redwood/metrics:prod-2
FF metrics_rewrite_v2=OFF
Instances: 6
Healthchecks: passing
```

smoke-bot: initial smoke OK. baseline p95=48ms.

deploy-bot: 0.25% toggle executed @04:10. cohort=internal_metrics + sampled traffic.

smoke-bot: post-step @04:18: p95 +6ms, error rate 0.06%.

deploy-bot: 1% toggle executed @04:25.

ops-oncall: infra.alert: metrics_queue rising at 04:28 -> pause.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by infra.metrics_queue. awaiting manual_confirm_on_pause.

harper: pausing rollout. can someone grab traces 04:20-04:30 for top slow requests?

anya: pulling traces - shows a spike on histogram-aggregate during shard rebalancing. looks like v2 triggers a small extra shard sync.

felix: status? does it meet rollback thresholds?

ops-oncall: p95 delta peaked at 72ms but not sustained 3m; error rate stayed below 0.5%. recommend step back to 0.25% and soak.

harper: agree. execute step-back and soak 20m. no automatic resume.

deploy-bot: backoff executed: 1% -> 0.25%; soak timer 20m.

smoke-bot: post-backoff smoke @04:45: p95 returning to baseline, error rate low.

harper: given the transient, we'll abort auto ramp and schedule follow-up. initiate rollback to be safe and apply pin; we don't want overnight surprises.

felix: ack. initiate rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback command received: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6499999999-Q` executed @04:50. flag metrics_rewrite_v2=OFF; pin applied pin-6499999999-eu.

ops-oncall: pin applied and verified; traffic reverted to v1. post-rollback smoke OK.

harper: adding to release notes: "slow ramp paused due to transient shard-sync p95 uplift; stepped back and rolled back with routing pinned to v1. Follow-up ticket #3420 created to add low-impact shard-sync staging."

anya: retro note: consider a preflight that runs a dry-run shard-sync on a small subset to surface this before traffic ramp.

deploy-bot: tb-6499999999-Q closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=felix; closed_at=6499990150

harper: thanks team. we'll reattempt after the dry-run and config tweak.
